name: Simbavati Fynbos on Sea
address: Sedge Links Golf Club, 1 Swartvlei Beach Rd, Sedgefield, 6573, South Africa
description_short: Bistro at Sedge Links with fynbos-framed fairway views and honest coastal cooking.
description_long:
Tucked into the Sedge Links Golf Club on Swartvlei Beach Road, Simbavati Fynbos on Sea brings relaxed bistro fare to one of Sedgefield's prettiest corners. The setting alone—indigenous fynbos rolling into fairways, with glimpses of the coast beyond—makes it worth the visit, whether you're teeing off or simply stopping for lunch.

The menu leans into South African comfort with a coastal edge: line fish, pastas, wood-fired pizzas, and hearty grills that suit golfers and families alike. Breakfast runs all day, and the outdoor seating makes the most of Sedgefield's easy climate. It's unfussy, well-priced, and genuinely welcoming—locals pop in as often as visitors.

Part of the Simbavati lodge offering, the bistro doubles as an event venue, but day-to-day it's a low-key spot for good food in a garden-and-golf-course setting. If you're exploring the lagoon or beachfront nearby, it's an easy detour that feels like a find.
